extracted.name: Grilled Vegetables
extracted.description: Learn how to make the best grilled vegetables! Lightly charred and flavorful, this recipe is a delicious cookout side or vegetarian entree.
ingredient_lines: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: Heat a grill to medium-high and spray with nonstick cooking spray.
Thread the vegetables onto 4 metal skewers. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill the skewers for 8 minutes per side, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Remove from the grill, season to taste, and serve with desired sauce or dressing.
